## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the affected documentation is updated.
- [ ] Relevant validation results and checks not run are recorded above.
- [ ] Public files and attachments contain no credentials, private configuration, SharedNet invites, or benchmark answers.
- [ ] Any adapted third-party code or data has source attribution and its notices preserved, or none was added.
- [ ] Claims distinguish observed results from intended behavior and missing evidence.
